fields.Name: T359 - Refresh Recordings List
fields.Description: Exercises the header mj-refresh-button wired to LoadData() with its IsLoading spinner state — a distinct re-fetch code path (reload of an already-loaded surface) separate from the initial-load render.

InputDefinition.goal: In the 'Realtime Recordings' application (reach it via the application switcher dropdown next to the logo), wait for the recordings screen to load — pages can take 10-30s in this environment, so wait, don't navigate away. Locate the Refresh control in the header actions area (a refresh/reload button) and click it. Success is that the list reloads without error — a brief loading indicator may appear and then the list (or the empty state) re-renders, and the surface stays functional. You do NOT need the row contents to change.

judgeValidationCriteria: A Refresh button is present in the header and is clickable
After clicking Refresh, the recordings list (or empty state) re-renders and the surface remains usable — a transient loading state is acceptable
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
